To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a deep learning model that automatically adapts the pedestrian detection model to a new scene without any manual labels and achieves the state-of-the-arts results on two challenging pedestrian detection datasets.
we propose a novel deep learning model to learn scene-specific features for pedestrian detection in video surveillance.

1) a scene-specific classifier can be learned by jointly optimizing the classifier and the marginal distribution of the source training samples; 2) the proposed cluster layer can effectively utilize the scene-specific visual patterns for pedestrian localization; and 3) the proposed method significantly improves the detection rate at 1 false positive per image (FPPI) by 10% on two challenging datasets compared with the stateof- the-art domain adaptation methods.
